title: Good product
text:
Good product. I like these lids. During my many relocations, I have lost a few "lids" from food containers and these guys fill in the missing lids. These are a little hard(er) to work with. They are definitely VERY difficut when WET. But are quite stretchable and once they are dry and streched accross, sticks to the surface pretty good. If the fitting is tight, they are pretty sturdy and other containers can be stacked on top of them.

Needs a bit of writst strentgh to be able to strech to fit and not sure if my 80+ mom can do it. So she just leaves them half covered for me to finish up. It's good that they send you so many with varying sizes. Haven't used the smaller ones yet but I am sure they will get used eventuially. The price-usefullness point is very high so I am keeping these in my kitchen drawers for future use. Currently using the larger ones.
